stem: Organisms need a source of energy for many cellular processes. Respiration involves the release of energy from energy-rich molecules for the synthesis of ATP molecules. ATP is described as the energy currency of cells.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Name **two** energy-rich molecules that enter the respiration pathway to synthesise ATP.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Fig. 1.1 shows a molecule of ATP.

{{figure:figure_1_1.png}}

Fig. 1.1

Explain the features of ATP that make it suitable to be the universal energy currency of cells.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text: Identify the type of phosphorylation reaction to synthesise ATP that occurs during glycolysis and the Krebs cycle.

parts.label: (d)(i)
parts.text:
Pyruvate moves into the matrix of the mitochondrion only when a particular inorganic molecule is present.

Name the inorganic molecule that must be present in the cell for pyruvate to enter the matrix of the mitochondrion.

parts.label: (d)(ii)
parts.text: Explain how the presence of the inorganic molecule named in **(d)(i)** affects the ATP yield from respiration.
